entries.en: The stream-stall hint now reads "Waiting for API response · will retry in …" instead of "No response from API · Retrying in …", and triggers after 20s of silence instead of 10s
entries.zh: 流停滞提示现在显示 "Waiting for API response · will retry in …"，而不再是 "No response from API · Retrying in …"；静默时间从 10 秒改为 20 秒后触发
